equivalent_texture_deduplication.scope: Derived preview XML/model only. Original source XML, images and author material definitions remain unchanged.
equivalent_texture_deduplication.equivalence_rule: Coalesce texture definitions only when their complete normalized XML structure is identical except for the top-level texture name: every other attribute/value, child element and meaningful text must match. Do not treat merely equal filenames or pixel sizes as sufficient.
equivalent_texture_deduplication.canonical_choice: Retain the first source-order identical texture entry; record every removed name as an alias to that entry.
equivalent_texture_deduplication.reference_remapping: Remap texture references to canonical names without changing material values, texture roles, UVs, texture transforms, sampling/flip/type settings or references to non-texture assets. Preserve every original material entry.
